user.title: Tiny Refuel
user.description: Petrol, diesel and EV charging from public sources. Initial collection runs in the background and can take several minutes.

settings.title: Update interval
settings.description: Price changes are stored locally. One earlier price per station and fuel is retained as a baseline. History starts when enabled.

vehicle.title: Shared vehicle
vehicle.description: Shared vehicles are used by vehicle sensors and cards without their own vehicles. Catalog capacities are suggestions; check the year and variant before saving.

remove_vehicle.title: Remove shared vehicle
remove_vehicle.description: Removes the shared vehicle and its sensor entities. Vehicles stored in individual cards are preserved.

catalog_variant.title: Variant
catalog_variant.description: Select the variant matching your year and powertrain, or enter the capacity manually.

map.title: Stations on the map
map.description: Opt in to physical station markers. Without a position entity the Home Assistant home location is used. Distances are straight-line distances. No map entities are created when disabled.

map_stations.title: Choose stations
map_stations.description: Up to 1000 matching stations are shown. Adjust the area or companies if needed. Your radius and marker limit still apply.

abort.catalog_unavailable: Catalog unavailable. Try again or add the vehicle manually.
abort.stations_unavailable: No matching stations. Load station data or choose a different area.
